'''Pipalidi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Navy/Legends|navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was in command of the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Commenor (starship)|''Commenor'']] when she [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|fought]] against the [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] at [[Sebaddon]]. After the conclusion of the battle [[Supreme Commander (Republic)|Supreme Commander]] [[Stantorrs]] considered promoting Pipalidi to the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]].
